summary: Added CONTENT_SECURITY_POLICY to src/sensei_top/api/dashboard.py above _SEPARATORS, with per-directive comments (React inline styles, no inline script, data: woff2 fonts, API-served card images). Split DashboardFiles.get_response: it now calls a new async _answer(path, scope) holding the previous body unchanged, then sets response.headers["Content-Security-Policy"] = CONTENT_SECURITY_POLICY and returns it. Pages, the index.html fallback, and assets all get the header, while /api routes stay untouched; LoopbackGuard's separate frame-ancestors CSP remains. Ran: uv run pytest -q tests/test_dashboard.py (20 passed) and uv run ruff check . (all checks passed).
concerns: Confirm the concatenated literal matches the required policy string byte-for-byte (verified as equal in a quick python check).
Confirm moving the body into _answer preserved all fallback/404 behaviour for subclasses or other callers of get_response (no other callers found).
